physicalTableDefaults.internalId: module-specific BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY; never exposed outside owning runtime
physicalTableDefaults.aggregateVersion: aggregate_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (aggregate_version >= 0)
physicalTableDefaults.auditColumns: created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL; created_by UUID NOT NULL; updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ; updated_by UUID; correlation_id UUID NOT NULL
physicalTableDefaults.rowSecurity: ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; tenant predicate current_setting('dwp.tenant_id',true)::bigint; application role NOBYPASSRLS
physicalTableDefaults.foreignKeyBoundary: composite (tenant_id,id) FK only inside same physical store; cross-runtime references are tenant-bound opaque public UUIDs with no DB FK
physicalTableDefaults.deletionRule: retention-class policy; terminal or ledger records use reversal/supersession and are never hard-deleted
physicalTableDefaults.indexRule: every work queue or as-of query begins with tenant_id; no unbounded JSONB search index
